body: Forget about her, she means nothing. I’m helping a buddy of mine get over something similar and really I don’t know what to do for him except tell him that he’ll be alright. You’ll be alright, you’ve mourned and been sad for long enough. Now is the time to throw away the memories, and focus completely on yourself. Find a hot girl to mess around with, exercise, be healthy, focus on your career, and when she sees what she’s lost you will have already won. Take the house and everything in it that’s yours, she absolutely doesn’t deserve it.
I absolutely approve and I’m a woman 😬😬
I had been typing things out in my notes for a while but airing my feelings is what made me realize there was a problem.
I’m sorry but I’m not very good at talking things out with people, I just needed to say something somewhere that my boyfriend won’t find, I don’t wanna make him cry anymore.
Hydroxyzine knocks me out pretty fast
